title: Samsung 32GB DDR4 PC4 2400T 2Rx4 ECC Registered Server RAM

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your server’s memory with the Samsung 32GB DDR4 PC4-2400T 2Rx4 ECC Registered RAM, designed to ensure exceptional reliability and data integrity in demanding business environments.


Engineered with ECC (Error-Correcting Code) technology, this RDIMM module automatically detects and corrects memory errors, reducing downtime and ensuring your server operates smoothly under heavy workloads.

Running at 2400 MHz (PC4-2400T) and operating at 1.2 V, this RAM provides both speed and energy efficiency.

Its 2Rx4 dual-rank architecture delivers optimized bandwidth for multitasking and data-intensive server applications such as virtualization, cloud computing, and database management.

Trusted by data centers and IT professionals worldwide, Samsung server memory ensures superior stability and longevity for mission-critical operations.


Key Features:


  • Model: M393A4K40BB1-CRC0Q
  • Memory Type: DDR4 ECC Registered (RDIMM)
  • Capacity: 32GB (1×32GB)
  • Speed: 2400 MHz (PC4-2400T)
  • Rank: 2Rx4 (Dual Rank x4)
  • Error Correction: ECC (Error-Correcting Code)
  • Form Factor: 288-Pin RDIMM
  • Voltage: 1.2V
  • CAS Latency: CL17 (typical)
  • Compatibility: Servers and workstations supporting DDR4 ECC Registered RAM
